vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component provides the core service layer for manipulating terrain data, enabling heightmap sculpting and material painting across a TerrainGrid. It implements tools like raising, lowering, smoothing, and noise application using deterministic functions operating on grid data. It manages state changes via TerrainHistory, allowing for undo/redo operations on both height and splat data.
